_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Map each letter to a unique digit so the arithmetic holds.
Assign with `[A 5]`, re-assign anytime.

invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Laika {letter} gaw puzzle hta n lawm ai.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Ga si a shawng na digit gaw 0 n mai rai ai.

outcome.incorrect: Mapping ngut sai raitim equation gaw n jaw ai.
outcome.limit: Shamu shamawt ai lam htum sai.
